_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: The Open University's BA (Honours) Economics, qualification code R30: the real Stage 1-3 module list and credit structure (DB125, DD126, MU123, M140 at Stage 1; D217, M248, DD226 at Stage 2; DD320, DD321, M348 at Stage 3), cross-checked against the QAA Subject Benchmark Statement for Economics (5th edition, published 8 March 2023)
_items_source.version: R30 module list and stage structure as published in the OU's 2026/27 Social Sciences Prospectus, itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: This course numbers its own syllabus items per real OU module (e.g. D217-1, D217-2, ...; M248-1, ...; M348-1, ...; DD320-1, ...; DD321-1, ...; DD226-1, ...), plus a bridging quantitative-methods stage numbered MQ1-MQ4 covering calculus and optimisation tools the intermediate D217 module assumes. The OU's own internal unit-by-unit numbering within each module sits behind the enrolled-student VLE and was not accessible, so this course keeps its own stable id scheme rather than reproducing gated numbering, exactly as the LLB and PPE courses in this library already do.
